# `passportsim stop`

Destroy an instance and flush its artifacts.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_stop` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/stop` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim stop [instance] [--keep-artifacts] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | `<instance>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `keep_artifacts` | `--keep-artifacts` | `boolean` | no | Keep the artifacts (true). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/stop.input.json`](../schema/commands/stop.input.json).

## Output

Output schema: [`docs/schema/commands/stop.output.json`](../schema/commands/stop.output.json).
TypeScript types: `web/src/gen/commands/stop.d.ts` (`StopArgs`, `StopResult`).

## Examples

### Stop the only running instance

```sh
passportsim stop --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim stop --json -
```

### Stop one instance of several and drop its artifacts

```sh
passportsim stop --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "instance": "p1",
  "keep_artifacts": false
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "instance": "p1",
  "keep_artifacts": false
}
'@ | passportsim stop --json -
```
